sourceOfTruth.note: Dossier indicates consolidated design and locally tested core, not production validation.

tasks.title: Audit runtime, repo, docs and current deployment protections
acceptance: Confirm active branch and head SHA
Inspect package scripts and existing CI workflows
Locate and read master dossier and plan in full
Verify GitHub branch protection and Vercel production branch without changing them
Record baseline commands and results

tasks.title: Review security baseline and staging prerequisites
acceptance: Review RLS and authorization on affected tables/routes
Inspect security preflight and existing audit scripts
Confirm staging project and safe credentials are available
No production data changes

tasks.title: Integrate canonical kit simulation core incrementally
acceptance: Inspect existing domain and avoid duplicate engines
Add regression tests before behavior changes
Preserve unknown/null semantics and deterministic behavior
Feature flag remains off until acceptance

tasks.title: Validate schema and SQL proposals against actual staging schema
acceptance: Inspect actual schema and RLS before migration
Test proposed SQL on local or staging database
Version reviewed migration only after compatibility is proven
No destructive production migration

tasks.title: Implement idempotent jobs, outbox and recovery where required
acceptance: Stable idempotency keys and retry policy
Bounded retries and dead-letter or explicit blocked state
Integration tests for duplicate delivery and recovery

tasks.title: Complete external data connectors and ingestion
acceptance: Provider contracts and freshness documented
Provider failure and rate-limit handling tested
No fabricated availability, stock or freshness claims

tasks.title: Assess and implement transactional P2P reservations only where prerequisites exist
acceptance: Authorization and idempotency verified
Payment test mode used for all tests
Production payment and destructive actions remain disabled until explicitly configured

tasks.title: Validate mobile, Liquid Glass, accessibility and offline behavior
acceptance: Browser and mobile viewport checks on staging
Keyboard, contrast, focus and error states checked
Offline behavior tested without public OSM bulk downloads

tasks.title: Run realistic performance and capacity tests
acceptance: Load model and assumptions documented
Tests run against safe staging infrastructure
No claim of ten-million-user capacity without reproducible evidence

tasks.title: Production readiness, guarded rollout and post-deploy verification
acceptance: All required CI gates green
Branch protection and Vercel production branch verified
Feature flags and rollback plan verified
Deployment status and post-deploy smoke checks recorded
Final report separates static, local, staging and production evidence

completionRule: All applicable tasks and master-dossier acceptance criteria require evidence; blocked tasks are not done.
